title: well-known-spec v0.1.0
description: A convention for publishing versioned specifications at /.well-known/spec/{name}/v{x.y.z}.json. Conforming spec documents are JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) with $schema, $id, and title set. The latest version of a spec is also served at the bare-name URL /.well-known/spec/{name}.json. Narrative at https://ben.abbitt.me/posts/well-known-spec/.

$schema.description: MUST identify the JSON Schema dialect. RECOMMENDED: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema.

$id.description: MUST be the canonical versioned URL of the spec document, ending in /v{x.y.z}.json where {x.y.z} is a semver 2.0.0 version. MUST NOT be the latest-alias URL.

title.description: Human-readable spec name including the version, e.g. 'deployment-version v0.1.0'.

description.description: RECOMMENDED. Abstract describing the spec; SHOULD include the narrative URL.
